---
name: "nf-core/fastq_align_bowtie2"
description: "Align reads to a reference genome using bowtie2 then sort with samtools"
keywords:
- "align"
- "fasta"
- "genome"
- "reference"
components:
- "bowtie2/align"
- "samtools/sort"
- "samtools/index"
- "samtools/stats"
- "samtools/idxstats"
- "samtools/flagstat"
- "bam_sort_stats_samtools"
input:
- ch_reads:
    type: "file"
    description: "Channel containing a list of input FastQ files of size 1 and 2 for\
      \ single-end\nand paired-end data, respectively.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ [ path(reads) ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*.fastq.gz"
- ch_index:
    type: "file"
    description: "Channel containing the Bowtie2 genome index directory.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta2), path(index) ]\n"
- save_unaligned:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Save reads that do not map to the reference (true) or discard them\
      \ (false)\n(default: false)\n"
- sort_bam:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Use samtools sort (true) or samtools view (false)\n"
    default: false
- ch_fasta_fai:
    type: "file"
    description: "Channel containing the reference fasta file and its index.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta3), path(fasta), path(fai) ]\n"
output:
- bam_orig:
    type: "file"
    description: "BAM file straight out of Bowtie2, before sorting.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(bam) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.bam"
- log_out:
    type: "file"
    description: "Bowtie2 alignment log.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(log) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.log"
- fastq:
    type: "file"
    description: "Unaligned FastQ files, emitted when `save_unaligned` is true.\n\n\
      Structure: [ val(meta), [ path(fastq) ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*.fastq.gz"
- bam:
    type: "file"
    description: "Sorted BAM file containing read alignments.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(bam) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.bam"
- index:
    type: "file"
    description: "Index for the sorted BAM file.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(index)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{bai,csi,crai}"
- stats:
    type: "file"
    description: "File containing samtools stats output.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(stats) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.stats"
- flagstat:
    type: "file"
    description: "File containing samtools flagstat output.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(flagstat) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.flagstat"
- idxstats:
    type: "file"
    description: "File containing samtools idxstats output.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(idxstats) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.idxstats"
authors:
- "@drpatelh"
maintainers:
- "@drpatelh"
version: "0.0.0-3c23b0c"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/bowtie2/align@0.0.0-3c23b0c"
  - "nf-core/bam_sort_stats_samtools@0.0.0-df69bf6"
